Relic refers to a type of equipment worn in the relic equipment slot by death knights, druids, paladins and shamans. Relics give a significant bonus to a specific spell or ability, either as a passive equip or chance to proc effect (similar to trinkets of the same nature). Relics were added in Patch 1.10.0, replacing the previously vacant ranged weapon slot for these classes. There were originally four different types of relics, each specific to a class: *Idols used by Druids. *Librams used by Paladins. *Totems used by Shamans. * Sigils used by Death knights. These relic types were merged into one type (named Relic) in patch 4.0.1. Relics and the relic slot were removed in patch 5.0.4.

A religious community tends to the faith and healing of the rest of the community, aiding them with all things spiritual. In wandering tauren tribes, the religious community may be but a single shaman or spiritwalker. In the time of Queen Azshara, the religious community of Suramar was a complicated structure intimately intertwined with the arcane community and involving nearly everyone in the city. Each culture on Azeroth has its own religious practices, and whether in the smallest town or the largest metropolis, those practices are supported by the religious community. Any player may resurrect themselves by running back to their corpse as a ghost from a graveyard. Spirit Healers, who are always available at a graveyard, can resurrect a player with a penalty of increased durability loss and resurrection sickness.

Rest is a system whereby characters may accumulate a bonus modifier for experience point (XP) gains. Earning XP from certain sources while rested will grant additional XP, but will consume part of the rest state or bonus. The bonus is gained slowly while the character logged out, and more rapidly whenever the character is in an inn or city. A character's rest bonus is displayed along the top of their XP bar. The rest bonus serves several purposes. Its presence allows players who play less often to level their characters at an increased rate, while its absence encourages players who are playing frequently or for prolonged periods to take a break, or level an alt. A retcon (short for retroactive continuity) is a retroactive expansion or alteration in the official lore of a series of works of fiction. These changes can either be: *Additional backstory to explain and expand upon present circumstances. :OR *Historical facts which are rewritten and are meant to be taken as having always been that way. A large portion of the lore of the Warcraft universe would fall under the first meaning, since it was all developed around a relatively simple war between orcs and humans. This article deals with the second meaning of retcon, a retroactive change in the history or backstory. Some apparently conflicting lore is actually written as flavor lore, and was not nec

The Revival Catalyst Console is an object outside Tyrhold in Thaldraszus that lets players convert non-tier Dragonflight loot into the tier equivalent. Unlock the console by completing Reviving the Machine, then pick up the weekly Revival Catalyst (quest) quest and complete group content to add Catalyst Charges to the console. Charges are earned account-wide, but are spent on a per-character basis. That is, each character on the account can individually use the same charge. In patch 10.1, players will be offered The Catalyst's Boon, which removes the weekly quest requirement. Simply logging in is enough to add Catalyst Charges.

Riggle Bassbait is the goblin who organizes the Stranglethorn Fishing Extravaganza, together with his mechanical help Fishbot 5000 and his assistant Jang in Booty Bay. Riggle is situated outside on a dock, so Bloodsail Buccaneers with flying mounts can reach him and turn in before the Booty Bay Bruisers finish them off.

Ridgepoint Tower is one of the scout towers of the Stormwind Guard in Elwynn Forest. These towers are well defended against any enemies who encroach into human lands. Ridgepoint in particular serves as a watchpost against the advances of the gnolls and orcs from Redridge Mountains, undead from Duskwood, and the Defias from nearby camps.
Ribchaser is a rare mob gnoll found patrolling the gnoll camps by the Lakeridge Highway and the Three Corners in Redridge Mountains. He has a 2-3 hour respawn timer.

Richard Van Brunt is a Forsaken found in the War Quarter of the Undercity. Alongside Robert Gossom, Andrew Hartwell, Chloe Curthas, Riley Walker and Marla Fowler he's cheering for Edward and Tyler, who are engaged in a fight.
The Ridge of Ancient Flame is a ramp leading up the mountain to Rhyolith Plateau. It is here Kar the Everburning is found waiting and sends Unstable Pyrelords down in waves to kill the invaders.

Rhonda Molver is a Forsaken flight master located at Andorhal in the Western Plaguelands.
Ride the Wind is a Level 21 Windwalker monk PvP talent, enhancing Flying Serpent Kick by increasing your nearby allies' movement speed and giving them immunity to movement-slowing effects.

Ridgewalker is a tauren harbormaster of the secret trading post called Flayers' Point in Desolace. He is an acquaintance with the crew of the Wavestrider captained by Greydon Thorne. At some point after the Cataclysm, the crew visited the trading post and briefly met with the tauren.
Riftwarden Acolytes are void elves located in various districts of Stormwind City and in Darnassus. One is walking in Mage Quarter with a High Elf Sorceress.

__NOTOC__ Rhonormu is a bronze dragon located in Silithus. He fulfills the same function as Zidormi, allowing players to go between phases of Silithus before and after the zone was destroyed by Sargeras.

__NOTOC__ Rift Wardens are void elves located throughout Telogrus Rift. They are skilled in Void magics, and have recently joined the Alliance along with the rest of their race. One is seen reading a book.

The Riftrunners are an Alliance team that can be encountered on Island Expeditions. They can also be found idling in Boralus Harbor along with the other teams.

Riggol Spelldriver is a goblin located at Grom'gol Base Camp in Northern Stranglethorn, next to Squibby Overspeck. Since The Purple Princess is out of commission, he created a mage portal to Undercity to compensate.

Rifen was a Forsaken rogue who was one of many Horde assassins sent to attack night elf outposts and patrols in Ashenvale prior to the War of the Thorns. He had the habit of poking at his exposed collarbone, a tic that unsettled his partner Lorash Sunbeam. Rifen and Lorash prepared to ambush a group of Sentinels led by Commander Anaris Windwood near Silverwind Refuge. When the Sentinels were distracted by the arrival of Ferryn and Delaryn Summermoon, Rifen climbed a nearby tree and dropped down on Anaris, stabbing her in the back with both of his daggers, killing her. Ridge Skycallers are sethrak located on the Crackling Ridge in Vol'dun. They can sometimes be observed empowering themselves or other sethrak with the Stormtouched and Skycaller's Blessing spells, respectively. Many of them are also seen subduing Imprisoned Pterrordax with the Skycaller's Subjugation spell; the pterrordax are freed if the corresponding skycallers are killed.
__NOTOC__ Riathia Silverstar is a night elf ghost located in a ruined building in Zin-Azshari in Nazjatar.
Ricky Scoothero is a Mechagon mechagnome riding a Mechacycle on Mechagon Island. He passes by Rustshaper Milligan and Cork Stuttguard who comment on him.
Rich Monelite Deposits are mining ores which can be found and mined on Tiragarde Sound, Vol'dun, Stormsong Valley, Drustvar, Nazmir, Zuldazar, Mechagon Island, Dazar'alor, and Boralus.
Rickrack is a faerie located at Star Lake Amphitheater in Ardenweald.
Rhodochrosite is an Azerite elemental geode located in Island Expeditions.
Riftborn Scavengers are flying soul eaters located in The Rift of the Maw and Korthia.
__NOTOC__ Ribbed Mollusk Meat is a cooking ingredient in Dragonflight Cooking.

Righteous Fury is a paladin ability, learned at level 12. It greatly increases the threat generated by all of the paladin's spells and attacks, and remains until canceled or until the paladin changes spec.
__NOTOC__ The Righteous Orb is a white sphere, filled with the holy power of righteousness. Used in crafting.
The Ring of Demonic Guile gives the wearer increased mana regeneration as well as a bonus to intellect.
Ring of the Earthshatterer drops from Kel'Thuzad in Naxxramas.

Ring of Reciprocity is an epic ring for physical DPS classes that drops from Doom Lord Kazzak at the Throne of Kil'jaeden in Hellfire Peninsula.
Ring of the Shadow drops from Shadowhide Darkweaver in the Redridge Mountains. During , it was available via Crate of Salvage and Big Crate of Salvage.
The Ring of the Moon is a world drop from level 16 - 23 mobs.

Riley Walker is a Forsaken found in the War Quarter of the Undercity. Alongside Robert Gossom, Richard Van Brunt, Chloe Curthas, Marla Fowler and Andrew Hartwell he's cheering for Edward and Tyler, who are engaged in a fight.

Riki the Shifting Shadow is a member of the Shado-Pan sent to the Shrine of Seven Stars. She can be found on the lower level of the Summer Terrace. She tells adventurers how to find the enigmatic Klaxxi. She also appears in the Vale of Eternal Twilight.
Righteous Inspiration is an ability used by Murkalot during a Pet Battle.

Rin, the First Disciple is a gnome warlock featured in the Kobolds & Catacombs expansion for Hearthstone. She grants the use of five "Seal" spells that summon increasingly powerful felhunters, culminating in the Final Seal, which allows for the summoning of Azari, the Devourer.

Rilzit's Holdfast is a small camp located to the northeast of Mok'gol Watchpost, in western . It is a neutral flight point that serves adventurers seeking to get to Highmaul or the Broken Precipice. Its only inhabitant is Rilzit Mugshot, who stole his rylaks from the Iron Horde. It consists of a few supplies and light posts placed in front of an abandoned cave.

The ring was stored in the Statue of Eraka No Kimbul on the Terrace of the Fang and many years passed without anyone being found worthy to wield the relic. Eventually, Queen Azshara sent an army of Stormcoil naga to Darkwood Shoal to reclaim the ring, which she considered highly important to her plans. The Stormcoil drove away the Tortaka tortollans that dwelled at the shoal, causing the tortollans to seek out the nearby Temple of Kimbul to ask the loa for help. Rime of the Ancient Mariner is a passive racial ability for all Kul Tirans, that reduces damage taken from frost or nature damage by 1%.
The Ring of Akunda's Chosen is a quest reward from Shattered and Broken.

The Ring of Transference is the upper floor of Oribos, accessed via the four transport runes in the center of the Ring of Fates on the main level. The flight master and gates to the four main Shadowlands zones are here, as well as access to the Maw, by jumping into the Soul Pillar at the center. The attendants add a fifth gateway, to the newly-discovered Korthia in the Chains of Domination campaign.

Ring of Duplicity is a quest reward from Ring of Self-Reflection, part of the Chains of Domination campaign in Korthia. The toy does exactly what it says it does - it summons a ghostly mirror image of the player that reacts to emotes and such while standing still for two minutes.

Ring of Self-Reflection is found inside a Korthian Relic Box at on the Vault of Secrets island in Korthia. Open the chest with the Key of the Inner Chambers, purchased for 25x Cataloged Research at Tier 2 with the Archivists' Codex from Archivist Roh-Suir. The ring starts Ring of Self-Reflection quest, one of many relics for Reliquary Restoration.

Risen Constructs are bone golems found near Rattlegore in Scholomance. They have lots of health and powerful melee attacks, so casters stay back.
Riptide is a Restoration shaman ability. It is an instant cast healing spell that also does additional healing over time.

The Rise of the Zandalari trailer is the official trailer for World of Warcraft Patch 4.1: Rise of the Zandalari. The trailer shows the meeting of various troll tribes and their chieftains some time after the Shattering of Azeroth. The meeting is held by a mysterious prophet called Zul.

The rise of demons is the conflict that lasted many millennia between demons of the Twisting Nether and Sargeras of the titan Pantheon, who was later joined in the conflict by Aggramar. The conflict emerged after the rise of demons in the Twisting Nether and their terrorizing of mortal civilizations bringing ruin to world after world, and after the Pantheon learned of the demonic incursions that flared at the far corners of creation. It's one of the earliest conflicts in the timeline of the Warcraft universe.
__NOTOC__ Ripe Pumpkin Juice are looted from Ripe Pumpkins located just outside of Thunder Totem in Highmountain to the northwest.

__NOTOC__ Risen Soldiers are skeletons found wandering around in the Fleshwerks of Icecrown. They still wear parts of the 7th Legion Infantrymen uniform. Empowered versions appeared during Death Rising.
__NOTOC__ Risen Arelas Brightstar is a ghoul located in the Trial of the Champion.

Risen Grovewardens were treants located in Lor'danel in Darkshore following the Burning of Teldrassil. Some of them are seen coming from portals held by Shadowglen Keepers or awakening Nature's Guardians and channeling magic into regular trees.
Ripped Webbing is found in Lakeridge Highway in Redridge Mountains.
Ripa the Wind Ripper is a Zandalari troll flight master located in the Grand Bazaar in Dazar'alor.

Rippling Lifefury is a water elemental located in Lifespring Cavern in Highmountain.

__NOTOC__ Risen Ohuna are skeletal ohuna raised by Clan Ukhel in the Eternal Kurgans in the Ohn'ahran Plains. Some circle above the kurgans, while others accompany Ukhel Gravestirrers and fly close to the ground.
Rituals of Power is a mage-only quest in the quest chain to get one of three wands.

The River Arevass is a river in Silverpine Forest, running past Pyrewood Village. It probably originates from the mountains within Silverpine Forest and flows towards or into Lordamere Lake. On the bridge leading out of the village, the night elf priestess Tyrande Whisperwind, having traveled to Lordaeron to hunt down Illidan Stormrage, made a stand against the Scourge in order to save a retreating force of blood elves led by Prince Kael'thas. She succeeded in holding the undead back, but was swept downriver as the bridge collapsed. Rivendark's Egg is an egg among eggs that if used with 35 will call down Rivendark. The egg can be found in Rivendark's Perch in Blade's Edge Mountains.
Rixa Quickwrench is a gnome located at the inactive flight path of the Ironforge Airfield in Dun Morogh.
Riverwarden Tuushuu is a jinyu located near Poolwatcher Gui and Watershaper Sharu in the Shrine of Seven Stars. He appears in the Vale of Eternal Twilight.

Ritualist An'xa is an eredar located in Highmountain during the Legion Assaults.
Ritual of Bones are skeletal orcs located in Shadowmoon Burial Grounds.
Ritual Censers can be found in Tempest's Edge in Stormsong Valley. Interacting with it gives the player the Flowing Power buff.
